why: The closed outcome set every fixture must use. A fifth outcome is not renderable, which is how a panel would end up silently empty.

meanings.ok: the read returned data; render it
meanings.no_data: the source reports absence of data; render absence, never a green state
meanings.disabled: the surface's feature flag is off; render the absence AND name the flag
meanings.error: the read failed; render the failure with its reason, never an empty panel
